title: Physio Galenus: a modular decision support platform for AI-supported physical rehabilitation
description: Modular web platform that enables therapists to monitor the progress of patients in physical rehabilitation. It integrates a decision support system that automatically adjusts exercise programmes and routines from performance data, streamlining clinical supervision. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
